summary: Frontend-only verification at 980x1200 for the new Netflix-style single-composition movie card (cin2-hero). All primary acceptance criteria pass. boxoffice-hero present with height=240px; .cin2-hero-img naturalWidth=1280; .cin2-poster naturalWidth=780. Inside the hero: boxoffice-badges (CANLI GİŞE + YENİ FİLM), boxoffice-imdb-rating, movie-title ('ÖRÜMCEK-ADAM: YEPYENİ BİR GÜN', 2-line clamp, scrollHeight=clientHeight=36 so no truncation), movie-tag-dub, movie-tag-sub, movie-shelf-watch — all confirmed inside hero boundingBox. plot-toggle-btn (KONU ▼) opens boxoffice-plot glass panel inside hero, boxoffice-plot-text length=1005, boxoffice-plot-credits shows 'Yönetmen: Destin Daniel Cretton · Tom Holland, Zendaya...'; clicking panel closes it. All box-office data-testids render with meaningful values and no overflow (scrollWidth<=clientWidth): gross ₺94.5B, viewers 258.7M, local ₺449M, international ₺57.8B, rate ~$38,128/dk, local-viewers 1.87M, intl-viewers 185.6M, sources 'Box Office Mojo · IMDb · TradingView FX · Son güncelleme 09:...'. Currency tab TRY→USD changes gross from ₺94.595.079.251 to $2.022.943.881. movie-tile total height=604px (<700). sponsor-banner=1, footer-bottom + legal-body render. movie-shelf-watch opens movie-lock-panel (regression OK). 0 console errors, 0 page errors.
